lastInsight: MODE 4 - IDEATE: Status's real killer move isn't B2B2C SaaS - it's B2B2B financial identity infrastructure. Visa/MC spent decades building payment rails. Status is accidentally building verified identity rails. The endgame: license our identity graph to fintech/crypto/luxury brands. When Amex wants to verify a high-value customer for Centurion approval, they buy our identity score. When crypto exchanges need KYC that can't be gamed, they plug into our verified social graphs. We're not competing with Posh - we're building the identity layer for the next economy.
